name: gaias-songbird-enter-reveals-until-deep-beast-rest-to-bottom
notes: Gaia's Songbird (sHzSmygjWY): the first Beast ally (Gray Wolf) is the 4th card; it goes to hand and the three revealed cards before it go to the bottom while a marker becomes the top card. Pre-fix only one of them moved.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Enter: Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal a Beast ally card. Put that card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your deck in a random order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated enterAbilities["sHzSmygjWY:0"] / ["ZR8tnLruR6:0"] bodies (Gaia's Songbird, Silvie Earth's Tune) put the revealed-but-not-taken cards on the bottom with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myDeck"): Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" re-resolved to the SAME removed slot after the first and MZMove's already-removed guard silently no-oped -- only ONE of the revealed cards reached the bottom and the rest stayed on top of the deck (the existing gaias-songbird fixture only covered a Beast on the very top). The generated file cannot be edited (gitignored), so both closures are overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MZMoveTopOfZone(). The printed 'random order' is not modelled (the revealed cards keep their order).
